title: Add Explicit Geometric Face–Loft and Shaft-Lean Sensitivity
body:
## Problem

Fixed delivered loft excluded closure-related loft changes and could not investigate long-left/short-right patterns.

## Acceptance Criteria

Implement assumed shaft-axis geometry around each pattern nominal; matched baseline loft; separate axis and fixed-club pitch sensitivity.

## Validation

tests/tools/shot_pattern_analysis/test_delivery_geometry.py; test_physics.py; test_core.py

## Handoff

Branch: `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`. Current implementation and evidence are tracked in `docs/research/shot_pattern_analysis/issues/README.md`. Keep open until a merged implementing PR satisfies acceptance criteria or an explicitly permitted disposition applies.
